messages:
maria-peopleops: Heads up 10: we got multiple reports that the new scorecard rows are missing the rubric sections after last night's ATS deploy. Interviewers see only free-text and no rating sliders.

alex-recruiter: Interviewers are confused; some skipped ratings entirely. Candidates at risk of delayed feedback.

tom-hiringmgr: That's the template we relied on for calibration. If ratings disappear, we can't run the perf buckets. Any idea if it's a mapping issue or upstream schema change?

ats-integration-bot: Received webhook transform alert: scorecard_payload_v2 -> missing_field: rubric_sections.

kevin-eng: Pulling the webhook payloads now. Example payload shows "rubrics": [] instead of expected objects. Looks like ATS changed the field name from "rubrics" to "rating_sections" in the API contract.

rachael-talent: We rolled out a quick interviewer note: do not submit scorecards without ratings; hold and DM People Ops with candidate IDs. But we need a fix fast.

maria-peopleops: Emergency plan: (1) patch mapping in our integration layer to accept both keys; (2) schedule a short interviewer training refresher on how to fill the scorecard if they see the issue; (3) run a merge/repair for today's affected submissions.

kevin-eng: I pushed a small compatibility shim to the integration service to map rating_sections -> rubrics and backfill empty entries when present. Deploying canary now. PR #4122.

ats-integration-bot: Deploy started: integration-worker canary 1/2. Monitor metrics: scorecard.parse_errors and interviewer_reports.

alex-recruiter: Can People Ops send a tailored message to interviewers with screenshots and the temporary guidance? We should include how to add manual ratings if the UI shows only free-text.

maria-peopleops: Posted guidance to #interviewer-oncall and emailed all scheduled interviewers for the next 48h. Also booked a 15m drop-in at 11:30 for any live questions and a short recording for replay.

kevin-eng: Canary healthy, no further parse errors for 10m. Rolling full deploy. I will also run a backfill to migrate any submitted free-text-only scorecards to have placeholder rubric entries and tag them for review.

rachael-talent: Thanks 11: I'll notify the calibration leads to expect some artifacts that need manual reconciliation. We'll prioritize affected roles.

maria-peopleops: Postmortem items: update integration contract checklist, add schema-compat tests to CI for upstream vendor changes, and add a short section in interviewer training: "If you see missing rating controls, pause and notify People Ops before submitting." Closing for now; re-open if you see more. :white_check_mark:
